utility.name: QEMU/KVM development box
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Turns a VM into a nested virtualisation host: QEMU, libvirt, virt-install and build tools, a Debian cloud image for disposable guests, and helper commands that start a guest with a local QMP socket (devbox-new-target) and check that KVM and QMP work (devbox-check). The listed accounts join the kvm and libvirt groups. On Proxmox the VM is given CPU type host, which only exposes KVM to the guest if nested virtualisation is enabled on the node.
